name: @agentrica/mcp
description: Agentrica's 56 AI agents as a local MCP server (stdio): one prompt per agent, three read-only tools (including the departments' library) and two tools that send only after confirmation: agent ratings and token totals.
author: Giulio Simone Floresta

scripts.prepack: rm -rf dist agents starter .claude LICENSE && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp -R src/page dist/mcp/src/page && cp -R ../../agents agents && cp -R ../../starter starter && mkdir .claude && cp -R ../../.claude/agents .claude/agents && cp ../../LICENSE LICENSE
